a100.loads: cp.async: threads copy global to shared memory, 4 to 16 bytes each
a100.mma: mma.sync: one warp, operands and accumulators in registers
a100.name: A100 SXM4 40 GB

b200.loads: TMA, as on Hopper; tcgen05.cp copies shared memory into Tensor Memory
b200.mma: tcgen05.mma: issued by a single thread (or one thread of a CTA pair), operands in shared memory (A may be in Tensor Memory), accumulators in Tensor Memory
b200.name: B200 (as in GB200 NVL72)

h100.loads: TMA (cp.async.bulk.tensor): one thread copies a whole tile, completion on an mbarrier
h100.mma: wgmma.mma_async: a warpgroup (4 warps), asynchronous; B from shared memory, A from registers or shared memory, accumulators in registers
h100.name: H100 SXM5 80 GB
